column3: With respect to the Baldwin Hills Center Mortgage Loan (6.8%), the Phase I ESA required in connection with loan origination identified a REC in connection with prior dry-cleaning uses at the subject property, likely between 2004 and 2016. Based on the duration of dry cleaning operations onsite, the lack of previous subsurface investigations regarding the related dry cleaning tenant, and the nature of dry cleaning chemicals (including chlorinated solvents such as PCE and PFAS), the presence of the former dry cleaning business and the likelihood of a vapor encroachment condition is considered a REC. Partner recommended a limited subsurface investigation should be conducted to determine if the subsurface media has been impacted from the former drycleaning operations. The lender obtained an opinion of probable cost for remediation from the environmental consultant with an upper range limit of $1.46 million. In lieu of a Phase II investigation the lender obtained a pollution legal liability plus-type environmental insurance policy with $10 million policy limits per incident/ aggregate from SiriusPoint Specialty Insurance Corporation for an 8-year term (3 years past loan maturity) with a $25,000 deductible. SiriusPoint Specialty Insurance Corporation’s parent entity is rated Moody’s “A3”.
